subject: Renewal: service tier advancement, latency SLO & capacity bump
messages:
From: Alex Barton <alex.barton@brightco.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@brightco.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:06:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — stronger SLA and throughput for Q1 2027

Hi Logan,

Our renewal is coming up in January and the team at BrightCo wants to formalize a stronger support and latency commitment for the next 12 months. Usage has grown ~3x year-over-year and we expect another 50% committed increase if we can secure a premium SLA and predictable burst capacity.

High-level asks:
- Move to a Premium Support tier (24/7 paging, 4h critical response)
- 95th-pctl latency SLO for API (inference) around ~120ms for our typical payloads
- Guaranteed baseline throughput of 1.2M tokens/day with a 2x burst window for seasonal peaks
- A mutual action plan (MAP) that ties rollout and billing to milestones

Can you confirm feasibility and a rough delta to our current contract? Priya is on copy and will coordinate procurement.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Barton
Head of Platform Engineering — BrightCo

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. I can take point on usage and pricing delta. A couple quick clarifying Qs before we draft a proposal:
- Is the 120ms target for 95th pctl for single-turn text gen (no function-calls), or does it need to hold for chat+function-call workloads?
- Are the baseline 1.2M tokens/day and 2x burst requirements averaged over a month or measured as peak sustained per hour?

I'll pull the last 90 days of telemetry and overlay with your requested SLOs — will aim to have a first-pass doc by end of Wednesday. Logan, want us to include the MAP template and a priced 12-month uplift vs month-to-month?

Cheers,

Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — stronger SLA and throughput for Q1 2027

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — appreciate the specificity. We can absolutely support a Premium Support tier and a structured MAP. Attached is a working draft (BR-SLA-Proposal-v3.pdf) and a MAP spreadsheet (MAP-BrightCo-2026.xlsx). Summary of the draft proposal: 

Key SLA & support changes (draft):
- Support tier: Premium — 24/7 on-call escalation with 4-hour critical response, 1-hour P1 acknowledgement
- Availability: 99.95% monthly uptime for hosted inference endpoints
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile <= 120ms for single-turn generation under normal payload (<=1k tokens); for chat+function workflows we propose 95th-pctl <= 180ms (different quantization profile)
- Throughput & burst: baseline guaranteed capacity 1.2M tokens/day; auto-burst to 2.4M tokens/day for short windows up to 6 hours; sustained burst discussions optional on Dedicated plan
- Credits: service credits for monthly uptime below SLA tiers; credits for latency SLO misses will be scoped (we propose token-based rebate for sustained misses)
- Onboarding & MAP: 6-week technical onboarding with two checkpoints (Week 2, Week 5) tied to billing milestone (first invoice adjustment after Go-live)

Pricing delta: preliminary estimate is +18–25% to current ARR for the 12-month committed uplift (exact figure in attachment). If BrightCo signs a 12-month committed increase to the baseline tokens/day we can offer a 2-month pro-rated credit as a commercial concession.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to confirm telemetry mapping to the 95th-pctl targets (expected Wednesday EOD).
2) BrightCo to flag any non-starters in the draft SLA and MAP (redlines).
3) If redlines are limited, Marissa will review and confirm an approved concession range and we move to redline the contract.

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call this week to walk the MAP.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — stronger SLA and throughput for Q1 2027

Thanks Logan — the draft helps. A few follow-ups / requested clarifications from our side:
- The 120ms for single-turn looks fine; we do need the chat + function-call workflows to be tighter than 180ms if possible. Can Redwood confirm whether quantized variants would close that gap or if we'd need dedicated capacity?
- For bursts: the 6-hour burst window is useful but our peak behavior is sometimes a 12–18 hour sustained ramp. If we can get an optional sustained burst (at premium rate) that triggers automatically, that would be ideal.
- Credits: can we make the latency SLO rebate formula more concrete? We want a simple metric (e.g., 5% rebate for each percentage point of 95th-pctl breaches beyond threshold, capped at 50%).

Also — procurement asked whether Redwood can include an explicit escalation matrix (names/roles and guaranteed callback windows) in the SLA. They prefer to see at least two named on-call contacts for P1 and a guaranteed callback within 30 minutes for P1.

If you can update the MAP and the SLA with those items, priya and I will review and try to align procurement by Friday.

Appreciate it,
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-04T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — stronger SLA and throughput for Q1 2027

Alex / team — looping in to confirm commercial flexibility. Short answers to your items:

1) Chat+function latency: we can improve the 95th-pctl by ~15–25% with a tuned quantization profile and request routing; if BrightCo needs sub-160ms a day-to-day option is Dedicated capacity (we can price it), but we will attempt to hit ~160ms on Hosted with tuned kernels and a narrow model selection.

2) Sustained burst: we can offer an "Extended Burst" add-on that automatically scales for up to 24 hours (sustained) at a predefined premium per-token rate; available as a toggle on the MAP.

3) Latency rebate: we will accept a simplified rebate formula — see proposed clause in updated attachment: 5% service credit for each full percentage point of monthly 95th-pctl breaches beyond threshold, capped at 50% credits for the month.

4) Escalation matrix: we'll include two named escalation contacts and guarantee callback within 30 minutes for P1s; 4-hour resolution SLA remains the target for critical incidents but we'll add a clause for rapid triage within the callback window.

Commercial concession: we can approve the 2-month pro-rated credit for a signed 12-month increased-capacity commitment. I attached an updated MAP and the redlined SLA (BR-SLA-Proposal-v3.pdf with notes).

If this matches your expectations, Ben / Logan — please prepare the contract addendum and a short kickoff invite for next week. Alex / Priya — happy to join the kickoff to align success criteria.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
